sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Reservation module future bookings ka system hai — guest aaj call kare aur agle hafte ka room book kare, to wo entry yahin hoti hai. Front Office ka extension hai: reservation check-in pe convert hoti hai.

Analysis HMS me Reservation flow: Enquiry → Booking create (guest + room type + dates + advance) → Confirmation → Arrival day pe Front Office me Check-In → No-show/cancellation handling. Channel Manager (EXTRAs me) OTA bookings bhi isi me pull hoti hain.

subsections.title: 3.1 Reservation Form (Shift+Q) — Main Screen
subsections.paragraph: Naya booking yahin banta hai. Guest details, stay dates, room type/nos, rate aur advance — sab ek form me. Company/Travel Agent/City ke liye quick-add buttons bhi hain (booking ke waqt hi naya profile ban jata hai).

subsections.title: 3.2 Reservation List
subsections.paragraph: Saari bookings ki list — date range filter ke saath. Yahan se reservation edit, cancel, arrival letter print, ya check-in me convert karo.

rows: Edit, Cancel (cancellation letter), Check-In convert, Res Card/Letter print

subsections.title: 3.3 Look Up Rooms
subsections.paragraph: Dates dalo — kaunse room type me kitne rooms available hain wo dikhata hai. Booking confirm karne se pehle availability yahin verify karo.
